# ToolEvent

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened during processing with a tool.

## Scope note

Events representing the use of a tool (e.g. a CLI command such as pkm-day or pkm-health), distinct from ScriptEvent (an automation run) and AgentEvent (AI-originated).
